meta.name: The Winter War
meta.note: Control polygons are APPROXIMATE reconstructions authored for this scaffold. The Soviet line recedes in the centre and north through December and January: that is not an error, it is Tolvajarvi, Suomussalmi and the Raate Road.

keyframes.label: The Soviet Union attacks along the whole frontier.
Petsamo falls. The advance reaches the Mannerheim Line.
Tolvajarvi is retaken. The Isthmus offensive is fought to a halt.
The Raate Road. Two Soviet divisions are destroyed at Suomussalmi.
Summa is broken. The Mannerheim Line is through.
The Finns fall back to the rear line in front of Viipuri.
Viipuri is taken. The Moscow Peace ends the war.
